title: The Mahjong Girls' Night Hosting Table
description: A mahjong girls' night hosting table from Sam's Club: Cirquejong mahjong tiles in a carry case, mahjong paper plates and napkins, a herringbone charcuterie board and two Ello 40 oz tumblers.
intro: I have officially become a mahjong girl, and I am not even a little sorry. The Cirquejong tiles are the cutest set I have seen, lemon yellow backs with pink and green prints, and they zip into a cream case with orange trim. Add the mahjong plates and napkins, a big herringbone board of snacks and two tumblers so nobody steals my drink, and the kitchen island turns into game night in about ten minutes.

sections.heading: The tiles are the star
paragraphs: Maison Lude Cirquejong mahjong: 160 tiles and cards in a zip carry case, so it lives on a shelf looking cute between game nights.

sections.heading: Plates and napkins that match the game
paragraphs: Artstyle mahjong dessert plates (7 inches, 85 count) and mahjong 3-ply napkins (200 count). Paper, so cleanup is one trash bag.

sections.heading: Snacks and drinks
paragraphs: The Member's Mark herringbone bamboo charcuterie board holds cheese, grapes and crackers for the whole table. The Ello Port 40 oz tumblers with handles come as a two-pack in thistle pink and cornflower lavender.

sections.heading: What is real and what is styling
paragraphs: The products are the pieces linked here. The kitchen, food and everything else in the photos are styling extras.
